title: Note: the Block checkbox and this board

text:
You tick Block in the dev bar so live reload does not yank a page away while you are doing something.
This board does not need a reload. Cards arrive over the live log stream, so new cards and updates show up even with Block ticked. Only a change to the board's own code or styles needs a reload, and with Block ticked that waits until you reload yourself.
After you restart the server once, far fewer reloads will fire at all: until now, just reading a file counted as a change.
